snippet.title: In Hope Voiden - Reveal Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters—and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

The very first teaser of our game "In Hope Voiden" as seen in Games To Get Excited About by  @AlphaBetaGamer 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_e06C1_o6jA&t=784s

Wishlist it now on Steam if you dare! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726180/In_Hope_Voiden/
